def overlap_minutes(meetings: list[list[int]], k: int) -> int:
    starts = []
    ends = []
    for start, end in meetings:
        if start < end:
            starts.append(start)
            ends.append(end)

    n = len(starts)
    if n < k:
        return 0

    starts.sort()
    ends.sort()

    total = 0
    active = 0
    prev = 0
    i = 0
    j = 0

    while j < n:
        t = starts[i] if i < n and starts[i] < ends[j] else ends[j]
        if active >= k:
            total += t - prev
        while i < n and starts[i] == t:
            active += 1
            i += 1
        while j < n and ends[j] == t:
            active -= 1
            j += 1
        prev = t

    return total
